title: Samurai removal 6 of 7: a one-time safe cleanup of Samurai's leftover data, with a notice of what was kept
summary: On the first start after Samurai's removal, Maestro deletes Samurai's leftover files once and removes only merged, clean run worktrees; anything that might hold work is kept and listed in a closeable notice.

deferred.what: On macOS and Linux, npm puts symlinks in node_modules/.bin, so every merged, clean run worktree that ran npm install is kept as 'contains a link to another folder' and the notice says it still holds work when it holds only build output.
deferred.why: Safe direction (nothing lost) and Windows is unaffected; the fix needs a design choice on which links git may delete through.
